name: Jackie Ng
title: Cryo-EM Structural Biologist · ML for Drug Delivery · AtomBios
tagline: Engineering nanoparticles that cross the blood-brain barrier.
description: Cryo-EM structural biologist applying ML to drug delivery. Published in J. Biological Chemistry. 20nm nanoparticles for BBB crossing: 8× transcytosis, 3.2-fold brain accumulation. HK$7.05M funded. Lindau Nobel Laureate Meeting 2025. Building corona-programmable delivery.
